■ Stage Direction
"Hakka-hakka suru" = Heart pounding / nervous.
(I gave them snacks before, but I wanna properly thank them...!)

Urgh...!! ...N-Next time, I promise!!
Pleeease wait just a bit longeeeer!!!!!

(Sure hope I'm gettin' closer
to bein' a "city girl"... hehehe.)

Yeah... If I could, I wanted to show that I've gotten closer to bein' a "city girl"
and thank you proper...

Huh? No, no, no!
It's nothin' troublin' like that... not at all...

...Yukino Bijin had been acting strangely for a while now.
Looking restless and fidgety, hesitating every time she tried to speak.

...Could it be something that hard to talk about?
I decided to brace myself and wait until she was ready to tell me.
(...Yeah, there is! There is, but...)

Was it really that difficult to bring up?
Maybe it would be best not to press her. For now, I should――

Trainer! Good work today!
Thank you so muc―― much for everything today!
Hehe...

(Back when I first started, I didn't know nothin'
and caused Trainer non-stop trouble, though...)

A question about training...? Or perhaps
she had some dissatisfaction with it.
W-What I wanna say is――
...! Trainer!!!!!

(No way... that won't do!! I gotta say thank you proper...
No matter how embarrassin' it is, I gotta ask Trainer to...)

Whoa. Yukino, you care about your trainer a ton, don't you?!
Totally head over heels. If you two are that close――

J-Jaja!? Wh-Wh-What's the matter?!
I-I'm feelin' totally fine, y'know?!

(If Trainer hadn't set up
a trainin' plan just for me, even now...)
(Ask them on a date!!)

To me, that's kinda like proof of how much I've grown...
So if it makes you happy... that'll make me happy too.

(I used to think runnin' with weights was all it took to get stronger.
So, if...)

(After everything you've already done for me,
are you still tryin' to do even more for my sake?!)

(I can't say that out loud~! Not somethin' like that... so easily...
Aaah, my heart's goin' pit-a-pat~!)
I gotta go do some tire pulls next! Well then, excuse me!

(Have I grown any, I wonder...?
My times are gettin' faster, and my standard Japanese seems to be clickin' too.)

(Mmh... Lookin' back on it, though,
Trainer's been takin' care of me non-stop.)
Uuugh...!

Looks like you're workin' right now, so I'll give it to you during your break...
Wait, huh, what's that? "For Yukino Bijin"...?

Her face bright red,
Yukino Bijin paced restlessly around the room.
I see, so that's what's been on your mind~?
